messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered - INC-2026-7781 - monitor `edge-tls-error-rate` (region: ap-southeast-1). Alert: TLS handshake failure rate > 7% and ALB target flapping. Auto-page to #incidents and on-call.

pagerduty: Auto-escalation: paging dave (primary). If no ack within 2m, escalate to alice.

dave: acked. I'm on call. Starting triage: checking ALBs and edge proxies.

alice: I'm pulling observability and support tickets. Customers in APAC reporting streaming disconnects and aborted requests.

bob: looking at ALB (ap-southeast-1). Target group backend-prod-ap shows 40% unhealthy across two AZs. Health checks failing with TLS handshake timeout and occasional `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`. No ALB config changes in the last 3h.

carla: infra note: we pushed a Route53 weight change 30m ago to shift 20% traffic to canary nodes as part of cert roll. TTL was lowered to 45s earlier today to speed the rollout.

dave: that could cause mixed pools during propagation. If some clients hit canary without proper chain, handshake fails.

bob: running `openssl s_client -connect edge-canary-01:443 -showcerts` shows the canary serving a chain missing the intermediate CA. Mainline edge nodes have full chain.

eva: support: collecting customer logs. Two customers show `tls: handshake failure`, one shows `certificate unknown`. Sending notice that we're investigating.

dave: quick mitigation proposal: (1) temporarily shift traffic away from ap-southeast-1 to us-east-1 (failover weights), (2) force full chain reload on canary proxies, (3) increase ALB healthcheck timeout to reduce false positives, (4) collect pcap for failed handshakes. Thoughts?

alice: agree. But confirm capacity in us-east-1 before weight shift. Also, prefer incremental weight change to avoid overload.

carla: infra: us-east has spare capacity and warm instances. I can coordinate the weight change.

bob: preparing commands. Route53 traffic policy patch ready: switching 70% -> us-east, 30% -> ap-southeast for 10m window. Command: 
```
aws route53 change-traffic-policy-instance --id tp-789 --traffic-policy-document file://apac-failover.json
```
Executing now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-7781 acknowledged by dave at 11:02 UTC.

carla: applied weight shift gradually: now 60% us-east, 40% ap-southeast. Monitoring.

bob: ALB unhealthy count down 60s after weight shift. Still seeing intermittent handshake failures from a small subset of edge-canary nodes.

dave: can we reload certs on those canaries without full restart?

carla: yes, proxy supports SIGHUP reload. Initiating rolling reload on canary pool (5 nodes). Command: `for n in $(nodes); do ssh $n 'sudo systemctl kill -s HUP proxy'; done`

bob: logs: 3/5 canary nodes reloaded and now present full chain. Two nodes still draining connections.

eva: customer update posted: "We're diverting traffic and performing a fix for TLS handshake errors. Some users may experience brief reconnections. We'll update in 10m."

dave: bump ALB healthcheck timeout from 5s -> 9s to avoid healthy flapping under load. Also tighten unhealthy threshold to 2 to pull bad instances faster.

bob: applied ALB changes. Healthy counts improving.

carla: completed reload on remaining canary nodes. All canaries now present correct intermediate CA.

alice: monitoring metrics: handshake failure rate back to baseline within 180s of reloads and weight shift. Support queue trending down.

dave: attaching tcpdump and `openssl s_client` samples for one failing connection captured earlier to the PD incident for post-incident analysis.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: note added - "weight shift -> us-east + canary reload + ALB tuning". Marking as mitigation in progress.

eva: sent customer follow-up: "Partial restoration observed; some clients may see errors until their DNS caches expire (up to 45s). If you continue to see issues beyond a minute, please contact support with trace ids."

alice: holding for 10m quiet window before resolving. Assigning follow-ups: RCA (carla), runbook update for short-ttl Route53 rollouts (bob), alert refinement to include cert-chain mismatch signature (dave), customer comms template (eva).

bob: metrics stable for 8m, unhealthy target count down to 1 and dropping.

carla: all canaries confirmed with full chain. No leftover old certs.

dave: closing actions: revert TTL back to 300s after rollout to avoid client thrash.

alice: resolving PD in 5. Great work.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-7781 resolved by dave at 11:34 UTC. Auto-close note: mitigation successful; follow-ups filed.

eva: posting final customer note now. :white_check_mark:

carla: leaving runbook PR in #eng-runtime for review.

end of thread
